newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: UK expert sees higher investment in Bangladesh.
newsitem.headline: UK expert sees higher investment in Bangladesh.

text.p: British export promoter David Burton said on Thursday more British companies would invest in Bangladesh, especially in the energy sector.
"There will be increasing amount of British business in Bangladesh...I am optimistic about more British coming in Bangladesh," Burton told newsmen at the end of a six-day visit.

He said British firm Midlands Power was expected to set up a 150 megawatt gas-fired power plant in southern Chittagong. The company will get gas from another British company Cairn Energy Plc which is drilling off Chittagong coast.
Burton said another British company would possisbly set up a plant in Chittagong Export Processing Zone for porducing gas transmission equipment.

He said the trade ties between the two countries had developed significantly over the years. A British company will supply computer eqipment to the Chittagong port authority. A British team will come to Bangladesh next month to promote trade between the two nations.
Two-way trade in 1995 was around $400 million against about $300 million in 1994. Some 45 British companies have roughly $234 million investments in Bangladesh, according to official figures.
